title: HonderWood - Resorcepack
description: A texture pack for HonderWood server members! Adds HW branding, HW lore-related elements, and modifications to some standard game assets for the HW server.
body:
# Resource pack HonderWood!
Official resource pack for HonderWood! Featuring HW branding, unique lore-based elements, and custom modifications to standard assets, all designed for a deeper immersion into the server's unique story.
